text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During one of our summer camp training

sessions...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heeheehee! That tickles!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thanks for the massage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It used to hurt a bit, but lately it's been
totally
fine! More than anything, it just
kinda tickles!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For a while there I was worried I wouldn't
be able
to enter the Kikuka Sho, but
now it'll be a piece
of carrot cake!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to the hard work you've
been doing
to help me get through this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll pay you back by bringing the
victory
home with me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, I've been trying to think
up some
training methods that'll be
easier on my legs.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since we made a promise to both work
hard, I was
thinking maybe there was
something I could do
too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, the first one I thought of is water
volleyball.
Since it's in the water, I won't
have to use my legs
as much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The second option is free diving! If I'm
lucky, I
might even catch some sea
urchins!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well, the best kind of training is
something
I can enjoy!
choice_data_list: どっちも遊びのような……

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just about having fun, you
know.
Activities that use your whole
body really do give
you a good workout.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Come on, whaddya say?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! I can't wait!
choice_data_list: じゃあ水中バレーをしようか
じゃあ素潜りをしようか

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you go change into your swimsuit
while I
go get the ball!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh! I can't play volleyball by
myself!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Anyways! Get changed already! I'm not
gonna go
easy on you either, you hear?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! You gotta be faster off the mark,
or you'll
never reach the ball in time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We play so hard, I break a sweat. This is

definitely a workout.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, then I'm off! I promise I'll bring
you back
some goodies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio dives in. Some time passes,
and...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Look how many sea cucumbers I
got!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I grabbed every last one I could find, so
let's
chow down on 'em!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a staggeringly large pile of sea
cucumbers
behind Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I praise her for managing to collect so
many, but
tell her there's absolutely no
way we can finish all
of them.
